dct_description_sm: All elicitation materials from session with Nancy Jones on March 11th, 2025. This session begun the investigation into the acceptability of obviative subjects/agents of VTIs, VAIs and VTAs. The attitude verbs were tested by providing a context and test sentences with obviative subjects or agents.The verbs investigated were quit thinking about, agree, want, believe, understand, forget, hope, forgive, know, and explain.
dct_title_s: Elicitation Materials for Anishinaabemowin Field Methods from March 11th, 2025
